cards.name: 0. The Fool
cards.upright: New beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, free spirit, leaps of faith.
cards.reversed: Recklessness, risk-taking, hesitation, bad judgment, foolish delay.
cards.affirmation: I step into the unknown with an open heart and complete trust.

cards.name: I. The Magician
cards.upright: Manifestation, resourcefulness, power, inspired action, skill.
cards.reversed: Illusion, manipulation, wasted talent, trickery, poor planning.
cards.affirmation: I have all the tools and power necessary to manifest my vision.

cards.name: II. The High Priestess
cards.upright: Intuition, sacred knowledge, divine feminine, subconscious mind.
cards.reversed: Secrets, disconnected from intuition, surface-level focus, repression.
cards.affirmation: I trust my inner wisdom and honor the secrets of my soul.

cards.name: III. The Empress
cards.upright: Femininity, beauty, nature, nurturing, abundance, fertility.
cards.reversed: Creative block, dependence, smothering, insecurity, neglect.
cards.affirmation: Abundance flows through me and surrounds my life.

cards.name: IV. The Emperor
cards.upright: Authority, structure, control, father figure, solid foundation.
cards.reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, lack of discipline, loss of control, dominance.
cards.affirmation: I build my life on structure, discipline, and stable foundations.

cards.name: V. The Hierophant
cards.upright: Spiritual wisdom, tradition, institutions, conformity, beliefs.
cards.reversed: Rebellion, unconventionality, new approaches, hypocrisy.
cards.affirmation: I honor truth and live according to my core values.

cards.name: VI. The Lovers
cards.upright: Love, harmony, relationships, values alignment, meaningful choices.
cards.reversed: Disharmony, imbalance, misaligned values, bad decisions, conflict.
cards.affirmation: I choose relationships rooted in love, alignment, and truth.

cards.name: VII. The Chariot
cards.upright: Control, willpower, success, action, determination, victory.
cards.reversed: Lack of control, opposition, lack of direction, aggression.
cards.affirmation: I harness my energy and drive forward toward victory.

cards.name: VIII. Strength
cards.upright: Courage, persuasion, influence, compassion, inner power.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt, raw emotion, vulnerability, low energy, weakness.
cards.affirmation: My true strength lies in compassion, patience, and courage.

cards.name: IX. The Hermit
cards.upright: Soul-searching, introspection, solitude, inner guidance, truth.
cards.reversed: Loneliness, isolation, paranoia, withdrawal, exclusion.
cards.affirmation: In quiet solitude, I find the light of my inner wisdom.

cards.name: X. Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: Good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny, pivotal turning point.
cards.reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking negative cycles.
cards.affirmation: I embrace the ever-changing flow of life and trust destiny.

cards.name: XI. Justice
cards.upright: Justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect, legal matters.
cards.reversed: Unfairness, lack of accountability, dishonesty, bias, blame.
cards.affirmation: I act with integrity, equity, and absolute honesty.

cards.name: XII. The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Pause, surrender, letting go, gaining new perspectives.
cards.reversed: Delays, resistance, stalling, unnecessary sacrifice, stagnation.
cards.affirmation: I release control and allow new perspectives to enlighten me.

cards.name: XIII. Death
cards.upright: Endings, change, radical transformation, transition, rebirth.
cards.reversed: Fear of change, holding on, stagnancy, decay, resistance.
cards.affirmation: I gracefully release the old to make room for transformative new energy.

cards.name: XIV. Temperance
cards.upright: Balance, moderation, patience, purpose, inner harmony.
cards.reversed: Imbalance, excess, self-healing needed, hastiness, friction.
cards.affirmation: I bring harmony, patience, and balance to every situation.

cards.name: XV. The Devil
cards.upright: Shadow self, attachment, addiction, restriction, materialism.
cards.reversed: Freedom, release, restoring control, breaking chains.
cards.affirmation: I reclaim my personal power and break free from toxic bindings.

cards.name: XVI. The Tower
cards.upright: Sudden change, upheaval, chaos, revelation, awakening.
cards.reversed: Disaster avoided, delaying the inevitable, fear of collapse.
cards.affirmation: Breakthroughs follow breakdown; I rebuild on solid truth.

cards.name: XVII. The Star
cards.upright: Hope, faith, purpose, renewal, inspiration, spiritual peace.
cards.reversed: Faithlessness, despair, self-doubt, discouragement, apathy.
cards.affirmation: Hope illuminates my pathway, filling me with peace and trust.

cards.name: XVIII. The Moon
cards.upright: Illusion, fear, anxiety, subconscious mind, intuition, mystery.
cards.reversed: Release of fear, repressed emotion, clarity, uncovering truth.
cards.affirmation: I look past shadows and illusions to embrace clarity.

cards.name: XIX. The Sun
cards.upright: Positivity, fun, warmth, success, vitality, joy, brilliance.
cards.reversed: Temporary clouds, sadness, overly optimistic, inner child work.
cards.affirmation: Joy, brilliance, and vital success illuminate my life.

cards.name: XX. Judgement
cards.upright: Judgement, rebirth, inner calling, absolution, awakening.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt, harsh criticism, ignoring the call, regret.
cards.affirmation: I step into my higher calling without fear or self-criticism.

cards.name: XXI. The World
cards.upright: Completion, integration, accomplishment, travel, fulfillment.
cards.reversed: Incompletion, seeking closure, short-cuts, unfinished business.
cards.affirmation: I celebrate my journey, honoring the completion of this chapter.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.upright: New raw potential and a powerful fresh beginning in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Delayed start or missed opportunity regarding ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I welcome new opportunities with enthusiasm.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.upright: Balance, partnership, and essential choices concerning passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Imbalance, indecision, or misaligned priorities in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I make balanced decisions aligned with my truth.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.upright: Growth, teamwork, and early expansion in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Lack of progress, miscommunication, or delays in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: Collaboration and vision fuel my ongoing growth.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.upright: Solid stability, security, and firm foundations in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Stagnation, rigidity, or fear of losing control over ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I rest securely upon the stable foundations I build.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.upright: Conflict, temporary challenge, or loss regarding passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Resolution, moving past hardship, and recovery in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I grow stronger through every challenge I face.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.upright: Harmony, success, generosity, and progress in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Standing still, selfishness, or delayed recognition in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I share my success and accept help when needed.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.upright: Strategic planning, assessment, and perseverance in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Impatience, self-doubt, or deceptive shortcuts regarding ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: Patience and strategy guide my long-term effort.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.upright: Mastery, focused movement, and rapid progress in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Frustration, lack of effort, or energetic delays in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: My dedicated focus yields expertise and momentum.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.upright: Fruitful realization, self-reliance, and near completion in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Defeat, dissatisfaction, fatigue, or stress over ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I honor how far I have come and trust what lies ahead.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.upright: Culmination, ultimate completion, and legacy regarding passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Burnout, heavy burdens, or painful endings in ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I celebrate full completion and release heavy burdens.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.upright: Curiosity, inspirational messages, and fresh ideas about passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Immaturity, procrastination, or bad news concerning ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I remain open to learning and fresh perspectives.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.upright: Direct action, drive, and intense pursuit of goals in passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Impulsiveness, reckless speed, or complete inaction regarding ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I take purposeful, courageous action toward my targets.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.upright: Nurturing mastery, emotional intelligence, and authority over passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Insecurity, coldness, or codependence in matters of ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I lead with intuition, grace, and grounded mastery.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.upright: Leadership, external mastery, and full control over passion, ambition, creation, willpower, and vital energy.
cards.reversed: Tyranny, manipulation, or ineffective management of ego conflicts, burnout, misdirected action, or creative blockage.
cards.affirmation: I exercise wise leadership and command my reality.
